patch_list: Suppresses nonlinear (overlay / pause) ad requests and live-stream preroll ad timeline entries.
Plays the FALLBACK stream instead of the ad-stitched PRIMARY stream when the title advertises one (same mechanism as HBO Max's ad-free stream). Does nothing for titles without a FALLBACK stream.
Marks every server-stitched ad break as already watched, so the player jumps over mid-rolls and lets you seek past ad breaks. The first ad of a pre-roll may still play briefly.
